name: Shobal
overview: The name Shobal appears in Scripture as belonging to distinct individuals, each connected to important genealogical lines. As a son of Seir the Horite, Shobal was a chief or duke among the Horites, with his descendants named as Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam, highlighting his role in the leadership and expansion of this people group (Genesis 36:20, 23, 29; 1 Chronicles 1:38, 40). Additionally, Shobal is identified as a son of Caleb, fathering Kirjathjearim, indicating a link to the tribe of Judah and the land of Ephratah (1 Chronicles 2:50). These references show Shobal’s significance in the genealogical and territorial history of God’s people, underscoring the providential ordering of families and leadership within the biblical narrative.
